description: This file is a Perl script implementing a minimal skeleton filter for Git's filter protocol version 2. It handles packet reading/writing over standard input/output, processes commands like 'clean' and 'smudge', and manages the communication protocol with Git for filtering file content.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning a status and content.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, ensuring it is terminated by LF.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT with length prefix.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet followed by LF.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes current packet by sending a zero-length packet.
